hooks.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks claude-code post-task'
sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks claude-code post-todo'

python3 -c 'import json,re,sys
c=(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("command","") or ""
git=re.search(r"\bgit\b[^\n;|&]*\b(add|commit)\b",c)
tgt=re.search(r"export/|\.tar\.gz|results/|\badd\s+(-A\b|--all\b|\.)|\bcommit\b[^\n]*\s-a\b|\bcommit\s+-[A-Za-z]*a",c)
if git and tgt:
    sys.stderr.write("BLOCKED by .claude/settings.json: this repo forbids git write commands, and this one touches export/ (proprietary, gitignored), a *.tar.gz archive, or results/ (generated).\nexport/ must never be committed or redistributed. results/ is regenerated by `make all`.\nIf a human explicitly asked for a commit, have them run it themselves.\n")
    sys.exit(2)'

python3 -c 'import json,re,sys
c=(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("command","") or ""
if re.search(r"\b(pip3?|uv|poetry|conda|micromamba)\b[^\n]*\b(install|add)\b",c) and re.search(r"scikit[-_]learn|sklearn|scipy",c,re.I):
    m="WARNING from .claude/settings.json: sklearn/scipy are BANNED in this repo and are not installed on purpose. The agreed stack is stdlib + numpy + matplotlib on .venv/bin/python. Installing them will make the pipeline unreproducible for the rest of the team. Write the estimator by hand instead (AUC from ranks is ~6 lines).\n"
    sys.stdout.write(m); sys.stderr.write(m)'

python3 -c 'import json,sys
ti=(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {})
if "group_trajectories" in json.dumps(ti):
    m="WARNING from .claude/settings.json: group_trajectories() is BANNED. It hashes first_user_text[:2000], but 978/1000 first user messages exceed 2000 chars of shared boilerplate, so it returns 953 collision groups for 1000 independent trajectories. n is 1000, not 953. Use iter_requests() and first_user_text() only. See docs/CONTRACTS.md.\n"
    sys.stdout.write(m); sys.stderr.write(m)'
